hero.body: Every new agent session reinvents your brand — three near-miss blues, two border radii, buttons that almost match. Miswadah reads the system out of the code you already shipped and holds every agent to it.
hero.note: Under ten minutes to your first on-brand generation.

how.title: Extract once. On-brand everywhere.
how.step1Body: Paste one prompt into your own agent. It reads your shipped styling — the real colours, type, spacing, and the rules the code already follows — and your design system materialises, token by token.
how.step2Body: One command wires any repo. Your agents consult the system over MCP before they generate anything visual — no reminders, no pasted hex codes, no screenshots.
how.step3Body: Every generation is checked before you see it. Off-brand values come back named, with the token to use instead — across every project and every teammate.

guarantee.timeBody: Sign-up to first on-brand generation in under ten minutes on your real repo. The worst case is that you walk away with the best design-system files you have ever had.

faq.title: Fair questions
faq.q1: Is this just a fancy DESIGN.md?
faq.a1: A DESIGN.md goes stale the moment your brand shifts, and it cannot follow you to the next repo, session, or teammate. Miswadah is live infrastructure: one canonical, versioned system served over MCP to every agent — and every generation is checked against it, which no document can do. If you want the file anyway, export produces a better one than the one you are maintaining by hand.
faq.q2: Will it capture my brand, or impose its own?
faq.a2: Yours. Extraction reads your shipped code — the real colours, type, spacing, and usage rules your app already has. Miswadah's own interface stays black, white, and grey precisely so your system is the only opinion on screen.
faq.q3: Which agents does it work with?
faq.a3: Anything that speaks MCP — Claude Code and Cursor out of the box; init writes both configs. The rules block teaches the agent to consult the system before visual work and verify after, with no per-prompt reminding.
faq.a4: Colours are compared perceptually, in CIELAB: within ΔE 2 of a token passes, which survives hex rounding but still catches the near-miss blue. Spacing, type, and radii must land exactly on their scales, after rem and px are normalised against each other.
faq.a5: You keep everything. Export your DESIGN.md and design-tokens JSON at any moment, on any plan. Downgrading never deletes anything — your history and your system stay intact.

useCases.reviewTitle: Every agent change, reviewed against your design system.
useCases.reviewBody: Agents drift — a near-miss blue, a spacing value your system never defined. Miswadah checks every generation and catches off-brand values before they reach your codebase.
useCases.driftTitle: Drift ships one small change at a time
useCases.drift1Body: The agent reaches for a blue that is almost yours. One generation later there are three of them, and none is the brand.
useCases.drift2Body: A 14px gap here, an 18px padding there — values your system never defined, multiplying quietly across components.
useCases.drift3Body: A stray weight, a one-off size, a heading half a step too small. Each reads fine alone; together they read like a different company.
useCases.reviewCloseBody: Reviewing every agent change by eye is the job nobody hired you for. Let the review run on every generation, across every project and teammate — and see only work that is already on brand.
useCases.storageTitle: A single source of truth for your design system.
useCases.storageBody: Right now your design system lives in fragments — a stale DESIGN.md here, a screenshot pasted into a prompt there. Miswadah keeps one canonical, versioned system and serves it to every agent, on every project, for every teammate.
useCases.today1Body: Each copy drifts the moment the brand shifts. Nobody remembers which one is current, so the newest repo gets the oldest rules.
useCases.today2Body: A screenshot carries one session. The next session — or the next teammate — starts from zero, and the agent guesses again.
useCases.today3Body: The moment a second person with their own agent joins, there is no way to share design rules beyond sending a file and hoping.
useCases.live1Body: Your agent reads the app you have already built and pushes the real system up. No Figma library required.
useCases.live2Body: Every change is a version you can inspect and restore. The system evolves with your brand instead of forking into stale copies.
useCases.live3Body: Every agent on every project consults the same live system before generating anything visual.
useCases.storageCloseBody: Update a colour, a radius, a usage rule — every project picks it up on its next session. And your system is never trapped here: one click exports a clean DESIGN.md and W3C design tokens, on any plan, anytime.
